questions.title: Module Constant Multiplier
questions.description:
A geometry helper defines module `Area` with a constant `PI = 3`. Read a radius r and print `Area::PI * r * r`.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer r.

Output Format:
The integer product of the module constant and r squared.

Constraints:
1 <= r <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
module Area
  PI = 3
end
r = gets.to_i
puts Area::PI * r * r

questions.title: Include Mixin Greeting

Input Format:
Line 1: a name string.

questions.sourcecode:

questions.title: Prepend Override Chain
questions.description:
Module `Logged` is prepended into `Speaker`. `Speaker#speak(msg)` returns `"said: #{msg}"` and `Logged#speak(msg)` returns `"LOG: " + super`. Read a message and print `Speaker.new.speak(msg)`.

Input Format:
Line 1: a message string.

Output Format:
`LOG: said: <msg>`

Constraints:
Message length 1..50.
questions.sourcecode:
module Logged
  def speak(msg)
    "LOG: " + super
  end
end
class Speaker
  prepend Logged
  def speak(msg)
    "said: #{msg}"
  end
end
msg = gets.chomp
puts Speaker.new.speak(msg)

questions.title: Comparable Spaceship Sort Three
questions.description:
Class `Box` includes `Comparable` and defines `<=>`. Read three integers on one line, build three `Box` instances, sort them ascending via `<=>`, and print their values space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: three integers separated by spaces.

Output Format:
Three integers sorted ascending, space-separated on one line.

Constraints:
-1000 <= v <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
class Box
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :v
  def initialize(v) @v = v end
  def <=>(other) @v <=> other.v end
end
arr = gets.split.map { |s| Box.new(s.to_i) }
sorted = arr.sort
puts sorted.map(&:v).join(" ")

questions.title: Comparable Score Card Verdict
questions.description:
Two players hold a `ScoreCard` that includes `Comparable`. Read two scores, one per line. Print `First wins` if the first card is greater, `Second wins` if the second is greater, otherwise `Tie`.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer score A. Line 2: integer score B.

Output Format:
One of `First wins`, `Second wins`, `Tie`.

Constraints:
-1000 <= score <= 1000.
questions.sourcecode:
class ScoreCard
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :score
  def initialize(s) @score = s end
  def <=>(other) @score <=> other.score end
end
a = ScoreCard.new(gets.to_i)
b = ScoreCard.new(gets.to_i)
puts a > b ? "First wins" : (b > a ? "Second wins" : "Tie")

questions.title: Enumerable Reading Log Stats
questions.description:
A sensor readings aggregator class `ReadingLog` mixes in `Enumerable` and exposes `each`. Read n then n integer readings. Compute the total, the highest reading, and the count manually by iterating with `each`. Print three lines: `Total: X`, `Top: Y`, `Count: Z`.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: one integer reading each.

Output Format:
Three lines as described.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; -10000 <= reading <= 10000.
questions.sourcecode:
class ReadingLog
  include Enumerable
  def initialize(vals) @vals = vals end
  def each
    @vals.each { |v| yield v }
  end
end
n = gets.to_i
vals = n.times.map { gets.to_i }
log = ReadingLog.new(vals)
total = 0
top = vals.first
log.each do |v|
  total += v
  top = v if v > top
end
puts "Total: #{total}"
puts "Top: #{top}"
puts "Count: #{log.to_a.size}"

questions.title: Store Inventory Namespace Total
questions.description:
A retail store models inventory under the `Store::Inventory` namespace with a `Tracker` class. Read n then n `name qty` pairs. Add each to the tracker and print the sum of all quantities.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: `name qty` separated by space.

Output Format:
The integer sum of quantities.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; 0 <= qty <= 10000; name length 1..20.
questions.sourcecode:
module Store
  module Inventory
    class Tracker
      def initialize
        @rows = []
      end
      def add(name, qty)
        @rows << [name, qty]
      end
      def total
        t = 0
        @rows.each { |r| t += r[1] }
        t
      end
    end
  end
end
n = gets.to_i
tracker = Store::Inventory::Tracker.new
n.times do
  name, qty = gets.split
  tracker.add(name, qty.to_i)
end
puts tracker.total

questions.title: Comparable Version Sort
questions.description:
A software release tracker models versions as `major.minor` strings. Class `Version` includes `Comparable` and defines `<=>` based on `[major, minor]`. Read n then n versions. Print all versions sorted ascending, space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: a version string `major.minor`.

Output Format:
All versions sorted ascending, space-separated on one line.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; 0 <= major, minor <= 999.
questions.sourcecode:
class Version
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :major, :minor
  def initialize(str)
    parts = str.split(".")
    @major = parts[0].to_i
    @minor = parts[1].to_i
  end
  def <=>(other)
    [major, minor] <=> [other.major, other.minor]
  end
  def to_s; "#{major}.#{minor}" end
end
n = gets.to_i
versions = n.times.map { Version.new(gets.chomp) }
sorted = versions.sort
puts sorted.map(&:to_s).join(" ")

questions.description:
A banking service prepends an `Audited` module on `Banker`. When `transfer(amount)` runs, the audit module prints `[AUDIT] transfer <amount>` first, then calls `super` which prints `Transferred: <amount>`. Read an amount and execute `Banker.new.transfer(amount)`.

questions.title: Robot Skills Multi Include

questions.title: Enumerable Temperature Log Spread
questions.description:
A weather station stores daily temperatures in `TempLog` which mixes in `Enumerable` with a custom `each`. Read n then n float readings. Compute the average and the spread (highest minus lowest) manually by iterating with `each`. Print two lines: `Avg: X.XX` and `Spread: Y.YY`.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: one float reading each.

Output Format:
Two lines with two-decimal floats.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000; -1000.0 <= reading <= 1000.0.
questions.sourcecode:
class TempLog
  include Enumerable
  def initialize(readings) @readings = readings end
  def each
    @readings.each { |r| yield r }
  end
end
n = gets.to_i
readings = n.times.map { gets.to_f }
log = TempLog.new(readings)
total = 0.0
lo = readings.first
hi = readings.first
log.each do |r|
  total += r
  lo = r if r < lo
  hi = r if r > hi
end
avg = total / n
puts "Avg: #{'%.2f' % avg}"
puts "Spread: #{'%.2f' % (hi - lo)}"

questions.title: Comparable Enumerable Leaderboard Top
questions.description:
An online game ranks players by score (descending). Class `Player` includes `Comparable` with `<=>` reversed for descending order. Class `Leaderboard` includes `Enumerable` and yields players via `each`. Read n then n `name score` pairs. Sort the leaderboard and print the top three names space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: `name score` separated by space.

Output Format:
The top 3 names space-separated on one line.

Constraints:
3 <= n <= 1000; -1000 <= score <= 1000; name length 1..20.
questions.whitelist: include Comparable, include Enumerable, def <=>, def each
questions.sourcecode:
class Player
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :name, :score
  def initialize(name, score)
    @name = name
    @score = score
  end
  def <=>(other)
    other.score <=> score
  end
  def to_s; name end
end
class Leaderboard
  include Enumerable
  def initialize(players) @players = players end
  def each
    @players.each { |p| yield p }
  end
end
n = gets.to_i
players = n.times.map do
  name, score = gets.split
  Player.new(name, score.to_i)
end
board = Leaderboard.new(players)
top3 = board.sort.first(3)
puts top3.map(&:to_s).join(" ")

questions.title: Prepend Timer Logger Audit Chain
questions.description:
A transfer pipeline wraps an `Account` with two prepended modules. `Timer` prints `[T] start` before super and `[T] end` after. `Logger` prints `[L] <amount>` before super. Read an amount and call `Account.new.transfer(amount)`. The output reflects the full prepended call chain (Logger first, then Timer, then Account).

Input Format:
Line 1: integer amount.

Output Format:
Four lines: `[L] <amount>`, `[T] start`, `Transferred: <amount>`, `[T] end`.

Constraints:
0 <= amount <= 1000000.
questions.sourcecode:
module Timer
  def transfer(amount)
    puts "[T] start"
    result = super
    puts "[T] end"
    result
  end
end
module Logger
  def transfer(amount)
    puts "[L] #{amount}"
    super
  end
end
class Account
  prepend Timer
  prepend Logger
  def transfer(amount)
    puts "Transferred: #{amount}"
  end
end
amount = gets.to_i
Account.new.transfer(amount)

questions.title: Banking Namespace Taxable Audit
questions.description:
A banking system nests modules: `Banking::Accounts` contains module `Taxable` (10 percent tax instance method `tax_amount`) and module `Auditable` (class method `audit(amount)`). The `Savings` class includes `Taxable` and extends `Auditable`. Read an initial balance, create `Banking::Accounts::Savings.new(balance)`, then print the total (balance plus tax) followed by `Banking::Accounts::Savings.audit(total)`.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer balance.

Output Format:
Two lines: the integer total, then `AUDIT: <total>`.

Constraints:
0 <= balance <= 1000000.
questions.whitelist: module Banking, module Accounts, include Taxable, extend Auditable
questions.sourcecode:
module Banking
  module Accounts
    module Taxable
      def tax_amount
        (@balance * 10) / 100
      end
    end
    module Auditable
      def audit(amount)
        "AUDIT: #{amount}"
      end
    end
    class Savings
      include Taxable
      extend Auditable
      def initialize(balance)
        @balance = balance
      end
      def total
        @balance + tax_amount
      end
    end
  end
end
balance = gets.to_i
acct = Banking::Accounts::Savings.new(balance)
puts acct.total
puts Banking::Accounts::Savings.audit(acct.total)

questions.title: Comparable Tournament Bracket
questions.description:
A tournament ranks teams by score then by name ascending as a tiebreaker. Class `Team` includes `Comparable` and defines `<=>` using `[score, name]`. Class `Bracket` includes `Enumerable` with `each` yielding teams. Read n then n `name score` pairs. Print `Champion: <name>` and `Runner-up: <name>` (the top two after ascending sort).

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Next n lines: `name score` separated by space.

Output Format:
Two lines as described.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 1000; -1000 <= score <= 1000; name length 1..20.
questions.whitelist: include Comparable, include Enumerable, def <=>, def each
questions.sourcecode:
class Team
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :name, :score
  def initialize(name, score)
    @name = name
    @score = score
  end
  def <=>(other)
    [score, name] <=> [other.score, other.name]
  end
  def to_s; name end
end
class Bracket
  include Enumerable
  def initialize(teams) @teams = teams end
  def each
    @teams.each { |t| yield t }
  end
end
n = gets.to_i
teams = n.times.map do
  name, score = gets.split
  Team.new(name, score.to_i)
end
bracket = Bracket.new(teams)
sorted = bracket.sort
puts "Champion: #{sorted.last}"
puts "Runner-up: #{sorted[-2]}"
